name: agent-tree
description: Terminal side pane that shows a session's agents as a live tree: stop a sub-agent, send it new instructions mid-task, switch its model and effort, change the look.

columns.title: Width
columns.description: Columns of the docked pane; a width dragged by hand wins

maxAgents.title: Agents kept
maxAgents.description: How many sub-agents the tree keeps; the oldest finished ones go first

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts

animate.title: Motion
animate.description: Draw the spinner, the flow while agents work and the start intro

language.title: Language
language.description: Labels in German or English; auto follows the language setting

intro.title: Start intro
intro.description: The Agent Tree logo builds up in the pane when a session starts; click or type to skip

autoUpdate.title: Auto-update
autoUpdate.description: Once a day, install a newer Agent Tree from its marketplace
